name: Outlaw Tools v0.7.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.7.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.7.0

## Refinery And Inventory

- Stage refinery scan panels as create, update or skip, compare changes and apply the reviewed selection together without duplicate orders.
- See station queue totals and next actions. Estimated completion stays separate from confirmed readiness and owned stock.
- Optional local reminders appear while Refinery is open; system notifications are not provided.
- Move whole batches or exact partial quantities between locations, preserving QL, units and provenance. Preview changes and undo unchanged moves without duplicating stock.

## Data And Sync

- Existing player data migrates with a verified backup. Export, restore and first linking preserve move receipts.
- Moves synchronize atomically; conflicting stock and descendants stay excluded pending review. Recovery requires a conflict-free export or manual reconciliation.
- Update both Windows PCs before syncing; older peers are refused before player records are sent. Linux remains manual-transfer only. Player records stay on your PCs.
- UEX economy integration, Outlaw Link and Deck are separate upcoming milestones, not included here.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.7.0.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.7.0.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
